Trace, implement and test: Savings Account

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class SavingsAccount extends Account {
    private double minimumBalance;

    public SavingsAccount(int accountNumber, Customer customerObj, double balance, double minimumBalance) {
        super(accountNumber, customerObj, balance);
        this.minimumBalance = minimumBalance;
    }

    public double getMinimumBalance() {
        return minimumBalance;
    }

    public void setMinimumBalance(double minimumBalance) {
        this.minimumBalance = minimumBalance;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean withdraw(double amount) {
        if (balance - amount > minimumBalance) {
            balance -= amount;

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
}
